Confirmed: the main CRUD hooks live in `web/src/hooks/useMemoQueries.ts` (createMemo, getMemo, updateMemo, deleteMemo, listMemos, plus comments), and it uses `memoServiceClient` from `web/src/connect.ts:197`, which is created via `createClient(MemoService, transport)` — the generated Connect-RPC client for `MemoService` (generated from `proto/gen/api/v1/apiv1connect/memo_service.connect.go` / TS equivalent).

q17. `web/src/hooks/useMemoQueries.ts`; `memoServiceClient` (a generated Connect-RPC client for `MemoService`, instantiated in `web/src/connect.ts:197` via `createClient(MemoService, transport)`)
